markScheme.exemplarAnswer: A grade 9 response will: describe scrutiny mechanisms (PMQs, select committees, debates, votes); argue Parliament IS effective (committees expose failings, debates shape policy, rebellions can defeat government); argue Parliament is NOT effective (whips control MPs, large majorities mean government always wins, Lords can only delay); evaluate: effectiveness varies with government majority, media pressure and public opinion; conclude: Parliament has significant scrutiny tools but their effectiveness depends on political circumstances. Stronger scrutiny would require: free votes, empowered committees, and Lords reform.
